A '''B1 battle droid''' was stationed on the [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Subjugator-class heavy cruiser/Legends|''Subjugator''-class heavy cruiser]] the [[Malevolence/Legends|''Malevolence'']],<ref name="Shadow" /> as a [[Gunner/Legends|gunner]]<ref name="Episode Guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode003.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Shadow of ''Malevolence''}}</ref> under the command of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]].<ref name="Shadow" /> In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="ERC" /> this [[Droid/Legends|droid]] participated in the [[Battle of the Ryndellia system/Legends|Battle of the Ryndellia system]], where it was destroyed by Grievous out of displeasure for its performance, and was replaced with [[Unidentified B1 battle droid 3 (Malevolence)|another droid]].<ref name="Shadow" /> This replacement unit had been kept in reserve on the bridge for just such a situation.<ref name="Episode Guide" />
